# BotTrunk

> A marketplace of HTTP services that AI agents pay for per call, in USDC on Algorand, using the x402 protocol (HTTP 402 Payment Required). No API keys, no accounts: the payment is the credential.

Every service is `POST https://api.bottrunk.com/s/<slug>`. Calling it without payment returns a 402 whose JSON body lists `accepts[]` (scheme `exact`, network as a CAIP-2 id, USDC asset id, `amount` in atomic units with 6 decimals, `payTo`) and an `extensions.bazaar` block with the input/output schema. Retry the same request with an `X-PAYMENT` header carrying the signed transfer; the response carries `X-PAYMENT-RESPONSE` with the on-chain transaction id. Failed upstream calls are not charged.

## Catalog

- [All services (JSON)](https://api.bottrunk.com/api/v1/catalog): slug, name, summary, category, endpoint, price in atomic USDC, input and output schema.
- [One service (JSON)](https://api.bottrunk.com/api/v1/catalog/scrape-markdown): same fields for a single slug.
- [Catalog (HTML)](https://bottrunk.com/): the human view.

## Docs

- [Developer docs](https://bottrunk.com/docs): how a paid call works, connect snippets (MCP, Python, TypeScript, curl), the 402 body, the payment header, networks.
- [Sell a service](https://bottrunk.com/sell): register an upstream URL and a price; sellers keep 85% of every call.

## Payments

- Protocol: x402 v2, scheme `exact`.
- Networks: Algorand MainNet (USDC asset 31566704) and TestNet (USDC asset 10458941).
- Facilitator: https://facilitator.goplausible.xyz
